description:
Consultant / Senior Consultant \- Data Management
CAPGEMINI INVENT
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting\-edge solutions. Join us in driving transformation that not only solves our clients’ current challenges but unlocks future value and delivers lasting impact. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.


Join Capgemini’s Enterprise Data \& Analytics (EDA) team working at the forefront of data \+ AI. You’ll play an influential role in designing and shaping data \& AI foundations that power cutting\-edge AI, agentic AI and advanced analytics, ensuring our clients trust their data, scale intelligent products and accelerate business impact.


YOUR ROLE
This role sits at the intersection of advisory, strategy and delivery, perfect for someone who thrives on shaping vision and guiding clients through complex data challenges. From enabling AI\-ready data foundations to embedding ethical governance for advanced analytics, you’ll help organisations unlock the full potential of their data.

* We **ADVISE** on data, analytics and AI strategy – You will act as a trusted advisor, shaping vision and defining AI\-driven data management strategies, articulating the business benefits of robust governance, quality and MDM capabilities.
* We **TRANSLATE** complexity into clarity – You will guide and influence senior stakeholders, bridging the gap between technical concepts and business priorities to secure buy\-in and drive cultural change toward data\-driven outcomes.
* We **DESIGN** operating models – You will define and design elements of the data management operating model, including roles, processes, standards and stewardship frameworks, embedding these into client organisations.
* We **ENABLE** trusted AI and analytics – You will support the discovery and design of data governance, data quality and master data management solutions that ensure compliance, transparency and ethical AI practices.
* We **COLLABORATE** for impact – You will work alongside business leaders, developers, architects and data scientists to ensure governance, quality and compliance are integrated into technical solutions and AI products.
* We **LEAD** and **DEVELOP** talent (Senior Consultant Level) – You will lead workstreams, coach junior colleagues and shape best practices across accounts, contributing to thought leadership and capability development in data and AI foundations.


As part of your role alongside client work you will have the opportunity to contribute to the business and your own personal growth, through activities that form part of the following categories:

* Business Development – Leading / contributing to RFIs, RFPs / Proposals / Bids, Proposition Development, client pitches \& hosting at events.
* Internal contribution – Campaign development, internal think\-tanks, whitepapers, practice development (operations, recruitment, team events \& activities), offering development.
* Learning \& development – Training to support your career development and the skills demand within the company, certifications etc.

YOUR PROFILE
As a member of the Data \& AI Strategy Team you’ll be part of the future of AI consulting. We look for individuals who align with our core values, are creative problem solvers and have a genuine interest in AI and emerging technologies. You’ll be passionate about helping organisations unlock the potential of AI not just through technical delivery, but by driving strategic change.


Below are some of the key skills and experiences we look for in candidates. We don't expect you to hit every point – we want to build a team which has diverse backgrounds, perspectives and strengths.

* Strong advisory skills, stakeholder communication and problem\-solving skills
* Proven hands\-on experience designing and implementing data management, governance, or MDM solutions (consulting or industry).
* Practical experience identifying and deploying of at least one data management or governance tool, such as: Informatica, Collibra, Alation, Ataccama, Microsoft Purview.
* Candidates should be able to demonstrate prior project experience where they led or contributed to data management initiatives \- e.g., data catalogue implementation, data lineage mapping, master data consolidation, data quality, metadata management or data lineage.
* Experience defining and operationalising data stewardship roles and responsibilities within federated or centralised data governance models.

  

Desirable:

* Experience in AI\-related data preparation, data management use case identification, AI governance or Responsible AI frameworks.
* Understanding of model lifecycle management, bias detection and explainability.
* Familiarity with DMBOK framework.

  

Data management is a broad field and therefore we’re looking to hear from people with diverse skillsets. You should apply if you have experience in one of the following roles: analyst, data engineer, data architect and specialists that have expertise in areas such as metadata management and master data management.

  

WHAT YOU'LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE
As a Consultant / Senior Consultant, you will have the chance to shape responsible AI foundations for tomorrow’s intelligent enterprises.  

* A clear path to professional certification (DAMA, Cloud Data).
* The opportunity to support the delivery of bespoke AI products
* Access to our Data Academy and AI upskilling programs.
* Flexible working, wellbeing benefits and a supportive community that values balance and growth., contributing to cutting\-edge projects that shape industries, while advancing your own career in a collaborative and inspiring environment.


We are delighted to have received the “Glassdoor Best Places to work UK’ accolade for 5 consecutive years, to see what it’s like to work at Capgemini Invent, visit our Glassdoor page
NEED TO KNOW
At Capgemini we don’t just believe in inclusion, we actively go out to make it a working reality. Driven by our core values and Inclusive Futures for All campaign, we build environments where you can bring your whole self to work.  

We aim to build an environment where employees can enjoy a positive work\-life balance. We embed hybrid working in all that we do and make flexible working arrangements the day\-to\-day reality for our people. All UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements.  

Employee wellbeing is vitally important to us as an organisation. We see a healthy and happy workforce as a critical component for us to achieve our organisational ambitions. To help support wellbeing we have trained ‘Mental Health Champions’ across each of our business areas. We have also invested in wellbeing apps such as Thrive and Peppy.


CSR
We’re committed to using technology as a force for good. That means reducing our own carbon footprint and expanding access to the digital world for everyone. This isn’t just a statement; it’s a core part of who we are. In fact, Capgemini has been recognised by the Ethisphere Institute as one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies for 10 consecutive years. When you join us, you become part of a team that does the right thing.


Your base location will be London, Manchester, or Glasgow, but flexibility is essential. These roles may require travel and short\-notice assignments away from home.  

We offer a remuneration package which includes flexible benefits options for you to choose to suit your own personal circumstances and a variable element dependent grade and on company and personal performance.


ABOUT CAPGEMINI
Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 350,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55\-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end\-to\-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fuelled by its market leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22\.1 billion.

**Overview**  



Data Connect (https://sheffield.ac.uk/data\-connect) is a strategic priority initiative by the University of Sheffield and is one of the University’s Centres of Excellence. It has direct funding from the University Executive Board and the Yorkshire and Humber Secure Data Environment (YHSDE) to develop a sustainable service to support Health and Social Care Data Research across the University and in the wider region.  



The Data Connect service team is made up of Data Managers, Data Scientists, Project Managers and draws on support from Platforms and Systems Engineers and specialists from other teams. There is a team of 16 people both across the University of Sheffield and wider Yorkshire region including the YHSDE and South Yorkshire Integrated Care Board (SYICB)  



We are seeking someone who is a strategic planner, who can ensure the Data Connect service is sustainable, adaptable, and positioned to meet the future demands of regional health data research.  



The individual needs to have the ability to manage a large and complex portfolio of work, balancing operational priorities with long\-term strategic goals in a fast\-evolving health and social care data landscape.A background in the technical practice, processes and governance needed to support research in the exciting field of health data is also highly desirable.

title: Graduate Data & Digital Programme
description:
**Graduate Data and Digital Programme**
**LET’S CUT STRAIGHT TO IT**
**At Severn Trent, we believe everyone deserves more. More care for the environment, more sustainable initiatives, and more support for the communities we serve. That's why we're on a mission to deliver bigger and better things, and we need passionate graduates like you to help us achieve our goals.**
**Our people and culture are the heart of our success. We're proud to be in the top 5% of utility companies worldwide for employee engagement and ranked as a Top 50 UK Employer on Glassdoor. With nearly 10,000 dedicated colleagues, we're looking for more brilliant people who are eager to turn challenges into opportunities for a better future.**
**If you're excited to learn, and ready to make a real impact, we want you on our team.**
**LET’S TELL YOU MORE**
 Our Digital and Data Graduate Programme within Data Science \& Analytics offers the perfect blend of personal and professional development. Within this programme you will have structured rotations through different technical disciplines such as Data Analytics, Data Engineering and Data Science whilst delivering tangible insights for some of the business’ most important data challenges.
   

  

 In a typical day you could be developing complex predictive machine learning models, presenting business critical analytics to leadership through data visualisations or even harnessing powerful AI tools to innovate our business processes. Working alongside our Innovation colleagues, you will be working on high impact analytics projects using real\-world data from our operational technologies.
   

  

 A critical and curious mindset, along with analytical and numerical skills are key for this role. You'll need to be an excellent communicator to be able to translate complex and technical data into meaningful insights for important decision making. You will be communicating with stakeholders on multiple levels, and assessing and prioritising work based upon business value. Furthermore, you will form close relationships with the wider Asset Intelligence Teams to improve our data strategy to enhance the availability, quality, and usability of our data.
   

  

 We welcome all graduates from diverse backgrounds, as we know diverse minds bring new ideas and a different way of thinking. We are looking for someone who wants to build their career with us and grasp new opportunities, and in return we will support you with varied experiences, training and development to provide a grounding for your future career.
   

  

**HOW WILL THE PROGRAMME WORK?**
 You will be based at Severn Trent Headquarters in Coventry, the heart of our patch. The programme requires you to complete 3 placements throughout your time in the role, gaining exposure in different areas of the department so that you are equipped with the right skills to build your career here at Severn Trent.
   

  

 Placement 1 – Working as a Data Engineer you will be working to transform prototype solutions built by the data scientists into robust ML pipelines that serve a production environment. You will learn about the myriad of data sources available to the Data Science team, ingesting, transforming and testing the data to enable the delivery of key, innovative data science initiatives. As part of the role, you will deploy MLOps best practices, including the monitoring of model performance over time.
   

  

 Placement 2 – As a Data Analyst, your strong scientific and analytical background will be put to good use working on fresh water and wastewater projects. You will build on the knowledge gained from the first placement, in databases and sources available to perform analysis of the data generating valuable business insights. You will develop analytics solutions to some of the most critical and exciting areas facing Severn Trent today.
   

  

 Placement 3 – As a Data Scientist, you will apply advanced algorithms and machine learning techniques to solve the business’ most challenging issues, extracting actionable insights that will make a real difference to the operations of Severn Trent. Building on prior experience in Data Engineering and Data Analysis, this placement will involve developing predictive models and supporting innovation that drives operational efficiency and resilience.
   

  

 In this exciting programme, you will have the chance to discuss your development and career ambitions in your 1\-1 meetings with business leads, mentors, a study buddy, the cohort leader, and the New Talent Team.
   

  

**What You Will Learn**
 You will expand your knowledge of;
   

  

* Water Treatment and Distribution
* Wastewater Treatment and Networks
* Data Engineering
* Data Science\& Machine Learning
* Data Visualisation and Storytelling
* DevOps \& MLOps
* Core Business Skills and Health and Safety


**What We Are Looking For**
 We want our employees to care and to have a genuine passion for what we do as a business. We need people who want to make a difference in providing a vital service to our customers, now and for the long\-term.
   

  

 If You Have The Passion To Succeed That We See In Our Graduates Every Day, You’ll Be a Great Match For Our Programme. We’d Love You To Be Someone With
   

  

* Curious and creative problem solvers with strong analytical skills.
* Ability to work across multiple platforms and engage diverse stakeholder groups.
* Excellent communication skills to deliver high\-quality reports and data visualisations.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy under tight deadlines.
* Proven ability to manage multiple tasks and activities simultaneously.
* Individuals from all walks of life – we celebrate diversity and individuality.
* People who show up, get involved, and want to make a difference because they care.
* A collaborative mindset and readiness to be part of something bigger.


**About The Programme**
 Our New Talent Team will guide you and support you every step of the way. Furthermore, your line manager, mentor and graduate buddy will be there to help you in making sure you reach your full potential here at Severn Trent.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Severn Trent Centre, Coventry, CV1 2LZ
   

  

**Programme Duration:** 
 27 months
   

  

**Starting Salary:** 
 £31,500
   

  

**Entry Criteria:** 
 A STEM degree background is preferred
   

  

**Driving Requirements** 
 : A full UK driving licence and access to your own vehicle is essential upon starting this role.
   

  

**HOW WE’LL REWARD AND CARE FOR YOU IN RETURN**
 It’s not just a job you’ll get here; you’ll get a career too. We have a range of benefits that reward and recognise great work and award\-winning training to ensure you reach your potential. And we’ll also help you play your part in looking after the environment and the community in which we live.
   

  

**Here Are Some Of Our Favourites**
* 28 days holiday \+ bank holidays (and the ability to buy/ sell up to 5 days per year)
* Annual bonus scheme (of up to £2,225 which is subject to eligibility)
* Leading pension scheme – we will double your contribution (up to 15% when you contribute 7\.5%)
* Sharesave – the chance to buy Severn Trent Plc shares at a discounted rate
* Dedicated training and development with our Academy
* Electric vehicle scheme and retail offers
* Family friendly policies
* Two paid volunteering days per year


 As if that isn’t enough, you’ll receive an annual salary increase whilst you’re on programme and you’ll also get an increase when you move into your first job.
   

  

**DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION**
 At Severn Trent we are passionate about our people. We want to make sure that we continue to foster a more diverse, inclusive, and cohesive culture that represents the communities and customers we serve. We’re making sure we keep up the progress with our wonderful working groups – LGBTQ\+, Women in Operations \& STEM, Disability and Ethnicity, who help us with our commitments. Find out more about our commitments to Diversity and Inclusion at Severn Trent.
   

  

**LET’S GO**
**Apply now to build an amazing career and be part of a brilliant team. We can’t wait to hear from you.**
* Roles close on 13th January at Midday (12pm)
* Check your diary – face to face assessments will run from through February and March 2026
* Estimated start date\- September 2026


 To find out more about working with us, search
 
 on social media.
   

  

*In accordance with Home Office guidance successful candidates will be required to evidence their right to work in the UK before commencement of employment. We have assessed this programme and do not consider that we would be able to sponsor a successful candidate under the Skilled Worker route as the role does not meet the relevant Home Office criteria; the successful candidate must be able therefore to demonstrate right to work without Severn Trent sponsorship.*

Our team leads and manages projects, programmes and portfolios required to define, develop and pilot new market\-leading business propositions in The Dock. These business propositions can take the form of pilotable assets, offerings, software and ecosystem plays. No two innovation projects are exactly alike.


As a business analyst, you may be involved in early stage proposition development, in reviewing and understanding the ecosystem and potential partners, in creating innovation strategy deliverables and in product development of the innovative solutions we incubate in the Dock. * Support the Innovation Lead and key stakeholders in assessing the project goals and defining the high\-level requirements
* Support the Innovation Lead across full lifecycle of project delivery (e.g. running agile ceremonies, workshop preparation \& delivery, representation at project status meetings, managing PMO deliverables, project content generation)

* Provide support to the quality management process e.g. Review of designs, prototypes and other outputs to ensure they fulfil expectations

* Build a diverse network across project teams, The Dock and previous project stakeholders to share ideas, lessons learned, and best practices
* Exhibit understanding of the Dock’s value model and services, offerings, and relevance to clients

  

Required

* Have a minimum 2:1 degree or equivalent from a relevant discipline
* Demonstrated organisational skills with the ability to prioritise tasks, work with schedules, manage resources while remaining focused on team goals

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* On project experience of agile delivery tools (e.g. JIRA, Confluence)
* Demonstrated examples of strong relationship building and interpersonal abilities, including with senior stakeholders
* Experience of working in teams
* Must be comfortable with ambiguity and adaptable to change


Extras that we’d love to see:

* Proven ability to thrive in environments of rapid growth and change
* Curiosity, interest, and experience in experimenting with emerging technologies
* Curiosity and interest in the value and commercial return of the work we do
* Strong technical business analysis skills in requirements management, process modelling, data analysis (SQL/Excel/BI), and familiarity with system integrations and agile tools
* Certification \& experience of Agile delivery (CSM, SPO)
* Project management certification (PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2 etc)

**Does this appeal to you? If so, we wish to hear from you.**

Please also note that Accenture is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all sections of society and does not discriminate on grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, or gender identity.


Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. With 505,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at www.accenture.com.

description:
**Company Description**  

Turner \& Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 62 countries.  

  

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.  

  

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.  

  

We are majority\-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner \& Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.  

  

Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com

 **Job Description** **About the Role**


We’re seeking an experienced Technical Digital Consultant (5\+ years) to deliver a range of services to our clients including, digital strategy, data management, system deployments, reporting and analytics. To deliver these services you will need to blend technical capability with a consulting skillset. As part of this role, you will need to define key commission deliverables, be confident enough to engage directly with senior client stakeholders and manage small teams of junior consultants to drive service excellence and client outcomes.


It is preferred if you have had experience delivering large scale data and digital transformation initiatives, experience within the construction/ property industry is seen as advantageous. The technical experience required to effectively deliver in this role includes activities typically performed by experienced business analysts or senior data scientists. Your technical capability will need to be complimented with a foundation in consulting, these skills will include, diagnostic analysis, report development, stakeholder engagement and strategic planning. As part of this role, you will need to be active in driving business generation initiatives, this includes networking, lead generation, tender responses and securing commission extensions.


This role is perfect for someone who loves connecting business objectives with technical solutions—hands\-on enough to develop and deliver, senior enough to mentor, and commercial enough to help win work.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Digital Strategy \& Advisory**

* Assess client digital maturity and define roadmaps covering data, platforms, integrations, and change management.
* Translate business goals into pragmatic solution architectures, implementation plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Facilitate discovery workshops and produce strategy artefacts (current/future state, gap analysis, sequencing, RACI).

**Data Management \& Architecture**

* Design and implement data models, pipelines, and governance frameworks (quality, lineage, security, MDM).
* Establish data standards, metadata management, and retention/compliance practices (incl. privacy\-by\-design).

**System Deployments \& Integration**

* Support/ Lead end\-to\-end platform deployments (e.g., CRM/ERP, CDP, marketing clouds, data platforms).
* Oversee API\-based integrations, identity/access control, and environment readiness (Dev/Test/Prod).
* Manage implementation partners and ensure delivery against scope, budget, and timelines.

**Reporting, Dashboarding \& Analytics**

* Define KPI frameworks and deliver executive dashboards and self\-service BI.
* Implement data visualization best practices and model datasets for usability and performance.
* Drive analytics use\-cases (attribution, segmentation, forecasting, performance optimization).

**Team Leadership \& Delivery Excellence**

* Lead and mentor a junior consulting team; set standards, review deliverables, and nurture capability growth.
* Own project delivery governance: RAID logs, sprint reviews, stakeholder updates, and change control.
* Champion documentation quality, operational handover, and ongoing support frameworks.

**Business Generation**

* Support opportunity discovery, scoping, solution design, proposals, and demos.
* Support the development of new service propositions and marketing.
* Contribute to thought leadership (case studies, playbooks, webinars, POVs).
* Identify upsell/cross\-sell opportunities through value realization and stakeholder relationships.

 **Qualifications** **Required Experience \& Skills**

**Must\-haves**

* 5\+ years in technical consulting across digital strategy, data, integrations, BI/analytics.
* Proven team leadership experience (mentoring juniors, leading small delivery squads).
* Hands\-on proficiency in data platforms \& BI (e.g., SQL, dbt, Snowflake/BigQuery/Azure Synapse; Power BI/Tableau/Looker).
* Experience with system deployments and integrations (APIs, ETL/ELT, CI/CD fundamentals).
* Strong grasp of data governance, security, privacy, and compliance implications.
* Excellent stakeholder management: translating business needs into technical solutions and vice versa.
* Demonstrated business development support (solutioning, scoping, proposal creation).

**Nice\-to\-haves**

* Exposure to CRM/ERP/MarTech platforms (e.g., Dynamics 365, Salesforce, Adobe, HubSpot).
* Experience with cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) and containerized deployments.
* Familiarity with advanced analytics/ML pipelines or customer data platforms (CDP).
* Certifications (e.g., Azure Data Engineer, Power BI, Salesforce, PMP/Agile).

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in either; Business Management, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Economics, Data/Analytics, or equivalent experience.

**Core Competencies**

* **Architectural Thinking:** Designs scalable, secure, and sustainable solutions for our clients
* **Strategic Vision:** Ability to identify key client solutions and articulate key strategic actions.
* **Communication \& Report Writing:** Strong executive presence, collaborative, creative articulate and concise in key report findings and recommendations.
* **Leadership \& Coaching:** Always learning, builds capability across the team, and promotes best practices.
* **Delivery Discipline:** Reliable governance, documentation, and risk management.
* **Client focused:** Outcome\-driven with the ability to deliver client value and identify new opportunities
* **Resilient:** Adaptable and confident in high\-pressure environments.

Culture Amp’s mission is to create a better world of work by empowering organisations to build cultures of growth, support, and continuous improvement. Your work as a Lead Product Designer on Coach will transform how people experience growth and development at work, making coaching effective and accessible at scale.  **Job Description** **About the Role**


We’re seeking an experienced Technical Digital Consultant (5\+ years) to deliver a range of services to our clients including, digital strategy, data management, system deployments, reporting and analytics. To deliver these services you will need to blend technical capability with a consulting skillset. As part of this role, you will need to define key commission deliverables, be confident enough to engage directly with senior client stakeholders and manage small teams of junior consultants to drive service excellence and client outcomes.


It is preferred if you have had experience delivering large scale data and digital transformation initiatives, experience within the construction/ property industry is seen as advantageous. The technical experience required to effectively deliver in this role includes activities typically performed by experienced business analysts or senior data scientists. Your technical capability will need to be complimented with a foundation in consulting, these skills will include, diagnostic analysis, report development, stakeholder engagement and strategic planning. As part of this role, you will need to be active in driving business generation initiatives, this includes networking, lead generation, tender responses and securing commission extensions.

* Identify upsell/cross\-sell opportunities through value realization and stakeholder relationships.

* 5\+ years in technical consulting across digital strategy, data, integrations, BI/analytics.

title: Junior Data Analyst
description:
**About Zeller**  

At Zeller, we’re champions for businesses of all sizes, and proud to be a fast\-growing Australian scale\-up reimagining business banking and payments.  

We believe in a level playing field, where all businesses benefit from access to smarter payments and financial services solutions that accelerate their cash flow, help them get paid faster, and give them a better understanding of their finances. So we’re hard at work building the tools to make it happen.  

Zeller is growing fast, backed by leading VCs, and brings together a global team of passionate payment and tech industry professionals. With an exciting roadmap of innovative new products under development, we are building a supportive and high performing team to inspire change in the outdated banking solutions. If you are passionate about innovation, thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new possibilities, hate bureaucracy, and can’t think of anything more exciting than evolving the status\-quo, then read on to learn more.  

As a Junior Data Analyst in Zeller, you will have a core role in our Data Team, in delivering the
companyʼs data analytics efforts. Your role is to enable and support data\-driven decision making
by building data models for business intelligence, developing rules for fraud detection, through to data quality assurance and governance.  

Our Data Team partners across the business to provide long\-term and short\-term decision making support. You are comfortable working cross functionally, internally and externally driving projects and providing insight, staying multiple ‘movesʼ ahead of where we are. You will have a passion for providing data\-driven insights and driving tangible business results.  

This is a hands\-on position where no task is too small or too big for you, ranging from day\-to\-day
data operations to architecting intricate long\-term data solutions.
### **Role Responsibilities**

* + **Data Analytics and Business Intelligence**
	+ Analysing complex datasets from multiple sources to support briefings, reports or executive decision\-making across the organisation.
	+ Creating dashboards for different stakeholders and providing intuitive visualisations for analysis, forecasting and continuous monitoring.
	+ Gathering and documenting business requirements for performance reporting, metrics computation and rule development for fraud detection.
	+ Applying statistical and predictive techniques to turn data into actionable insights
	+ **Data Operations Management**
	+ Supporting the team in designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines and architectures.
	+ Ensuring data quality, security, and accessibility in alignment with best practices.
	+ Researching, evaluating and integrating new tools and technologies to enhance data processing and management capabilities.
	+ Supporting Data Scientists / Machine Learning Specialists to efficiently incorporate data requirements into the growth roadmap.
	+ **Analytics Infrastructure Optimisation**
	+ Working closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver research insights and day\-to\-day analytical tools that inform decision\-making.
	+ Utilising data analysis techniques to identify opportunities for product enhancements, process optimizations, and data asset monetization.
	+ Contributing to the refinement of Zeller's strategies, products, and operations through the translation of data insights into actionable business outcomes.

### **Your background and experience**

* + 1 – 2 years of experience in Data Analytics, preferably in a high growth environment.
	+ Solid SQL fundamentals and the ability to evaluate logic and data models.
	+ Ability to interpret data and translate these insights into actionable outcomes and business decisions.
	+ Previous exposure to Machine Learning and AI models and their applications in business use cases.

### **Bonus points**

* + Proficiency in Python, R or any programming language for data analysis (especially Python).
	+ Exposure to the modern data stack (dbt, Snowflake / Databricks, Git workflows, cloud environments, Airflow / Dagster, etc.) is a huge bonus.
	+ Knowledge of Test\-Driven Development, Domain\-Driven Design and Event\-Driven Architecture.
	+ Understanding of database design principles and dimensional data modelling techniques.
	+ Degree in Information Systems, Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistics, or related fields.

### **Your attributes**

* + You love to challenge the status\-quo;
	+ Youʼre agile, ambitious, and motivated to be the best at everything you do;
	+ You are not bounded by a single set of tools – you love to embrace changes and learn new
	+ skills;
	+ Ability to work autonomously yet collaboratively with cross\-functional teams;
	+ Strong attention to detail;
	+ Presentation skills – ability to write and speak clearly to easily communicate complex ideas in a way that is easy to understand for non\-technical stakeholders;
	+ Structured problem solving skills and comfortable with ambiguity;
	+ Be able to continually balance speed, perfection, and actionable outcomes from your analysis

**How we work**  

At Zeller, we thrive on the energy and fast pace that comes from in\-person collaboration and this role is based in our Melbourne CBD office with a general expectation of 4 days on\-site per week with an option of 1 day WFH.  

  

  

**Like the rest of the team, you’ll benefit from**  

A competitive salary package, including equity;
A balanced, progressive, and supportive work environment;
Excellent parental leave and other leave entitlements;
A fantastic office environment;
Endless learning and development opportunities;
Plenty of fun and social opportunities \- we love to come together as a team;
An ability to influence and shape the future of Zeller as our company scales both domestically and globally;

For more information visit cultureamp.com.

Culture Amp’s mission is to create a better world of work by empowering organisations to build cultures of growth, support, and continuous improvement. The Coach product area helps unlock the potential of employees through impactful coaching experiences, advanced AI capabilities, and data\-driven insights.



Your work as a Lead Product Designer on Coach will transform how people experience growth and development at work, making coaching effective and accessible at scale. You’ll help define the design vision for future\-facing, AI\-enabled features and inspire a culture of innovation \- delivering impactful outcomes for millions. Collaborate with a passionate, cross\-functional team, contributing to Culture Amp’s broader mission of a better world of work.


#### **The Opportunity**



This is a pivotal role combining strategic vision, leadership, and hands\-on craft. You’ll lead the design for high\-growth product surfaces, championing personalised coaching journeys and AI\-powered features. Working cross\-functionally, your designs will help people thrive by making coaching accessible, actionable, and deeply integrated across Culture Amp’s platform.


#### **What You’ll Do**


* **Shape Product Vision:**  

Own and evolve the design direction for Coach, crafting engaging, intuitive experiences that address user onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention.
* **Lead AI\-driven Discovery:**  

Define, design, and refine user journeys for discovering and interacting with AI\-powered coaching features. Use AI as a creative catalyst to amplify product possibilities and outcomes.
* **Drive Design Excellence:**  

Uphold high standards in design craft and user experience. Rapidly explore, prototype, and test new concepts while considering edge cases, UX nuance, and interaction quality.
* **Champion Research \& Insight:**  

Partner closely with researchers and product managers to lead advanced quantitative and qualitative research, using insight to inform product direction and evidence\-based decisions.
* **Project Leadership \& Product Strategy:**  

Plan and lead complex initiatives across multiple teams and stakeholders, building clear project plans and adapting approaches to drive meaningful growth and deliver business impact.
* **Systems Design:**  

Design cohesive experiences and contribute to the evolution of our design system, seamlessly connecting interactions across broader product architecture.
* **Mentorship \& Influence:**  

Provide thought leadership, foster a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement, and proactively mentor other designers to raise the bar for design across the Coach area.
* **Collaboration \& Culture:**  

Co\-create outcomes with product managers, engineers, researchers, marketers, and data scientists. Shape team rituals and best practices, improving both product excellence and organisational culture.

#### **About You**


* 6\+ years of product design experience, including leadership of growth initiatives in SaaS or enterprise contexts.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating polished UI, robust UX thinking, and clear, measurable impact on user behavior and commercial outcomes.
* Hands\-on experience designing and optimizing AI\-powered features; fluent with modern AI tools to amplify creativity and design craft.
* Skilled systems thinker who links granular interaction details to overarching product architecture.
* Bold, visionary, and able to rally teams around compelling design narratives \- willing to take creative risks and push boundaries.
* Operate with high autonomy in ambiguous spaces, initiating, exploring, and delivering meaningful value without waiting for permission.
* Comfortable combining user research, product data, and design intuition to make smart decisions and unlock new opportunities.
* Detail\-oriented with the ability to move quickly, balancing speed and craft from exploration through delivery.
* Thrive in cross\-functional environments, driving co\-creation and shaping design culture, rituals, and best practices.
* Growth\-oriented and reflective: actively seek feedback, encourage improvement, and cultivate development of yourself and peers.


We believe that our employees are the heartbeat of our success. We're committed to fostering a work environment that truly cares for and develops its people, and creates lasting positive impact. In addition to providing a competitive compensation package, some of the key benefits we offer are:


* Employee Share Options Program: We empower you to be an owner in Culture Amp and share in our success
* Programs, coaching, and budgets to help you thrive personally and professionally
* Access to external providers for mental wellbeing and coaching support to sustain the wellbeing, safety and development of our people
* Monthly Camper Life Allowance: An automatic allowance paid out each month with your pay \- you can spend it however you like to help improve your experience and life outside work
* Team budgets dedicated to team building activities and connection
* Intentional quarterly wellbeing pauses: A quarterly company\-wide shutdown day in each region to to collectively pause, reset and focus on restoration and rest, without having to tap into individual vacation time
* Extended year\-end breaks: An extended refresh period at the end of year
* Excellent parental leave and in work support program available from day 1 of joining Culture Amp
* 5 Social Impact Days a year to make a positive impact on the community outside of work
* MacBooks for you to do your best \& a work from home office budget to spend on setting up your home office

* 5\+ years in technical consulting across digital strategy, data, integrations, BI/analytics.

This is an opportunity in the exciting and fast\-growing transportation technology industry. Public transit is being transformed from a system of static, scheduled fixed\-routes, to a dynamic on\-demand network, and you will be one of the pioneers shaping this transformation.



As the newest member of our Algorithms \& Optimization team, you will contribute to the complex suite of algorithms that power RideCo’s core ridesharing platform. The ideal candidate must possess a sound grasp of Algorithms and Data Structures, strong critical thinking and reasoning skills, and the ability to produce readable, maintainable, and working software programs from abstract concepts and ideas. You will thrive in a small\-team environment with fast\-paced agile iterations, where every developer contributes code that delivers a meaningful impact to our customers and the company.


**Your day\-to\-day responsibilities will include:**



At RideCo, you will be switching hats between Software Engineer, Researcher, and Data Scientist depending on the problem at hand.



As a Researcher, you will:


* Stay abreast of the research publications in the fields related to vehicle routing and ridesharing algorithms.
* Compare best\-performing ridesharing benchmarks from research papers with RideCo’s to ensure that we are staying ahead of the competition.
* Invent new algorithms to enhance the performance of our Optimization engine, both in terms of the quality of the solutions produced (e.g., sharing rate) and in terms of the speed at which we can converge to those high\-quality solutions.
* Produce scalable and performant solutions to computationally hard (and often intractable) problems.
* Contribute to the invention of novel solutions to fleet partners’ operational problems by collaboratively working with product managers, co\-developers, and our client success team.


 As a Software Engineer, you will:


* Contribute to a distributed platform architecture design for smart partitioning of the problem space, caching mechanisms, and microservices.
* Build systems to intelligently automate manual bottlenecks in service rollouts.
* Expand the system’s capabilities to new features and use\-cases while maintaining a high level of performance.
* Prototype, iterate on, develop, and test the ideas and algorithms that you invent.
* Build tools to gain greater visibility into the performance of our Optimization engine.


As a Data Scientist, you will


* Enhance the accuracy of the ETAs in RideCo’s real\-time traffic forecasting system.
* Analyze ridership data to develop models to predict ride\-demand, which will be used to reposition RideCo’s fleet of vehicles.
* Fine\-tune the hyperparameters in RideCo’s Optimization algorithms to extract greater value from the system.


**Your playground / what you’ll learn:**



At RideCo you’ll get a chance to play, learn and build with the following tools and technologies, and as part of a cross\-functional team that is the world’s foremost innovator in on\-demand transit software.


* Languages: Python, Rust, JavaScript / Typescript (Angular)
* Web Stack: Django, Flask, Gunicorn, Nginx
* Mobile: Ionic, hybrid apps for Android and iOS
* Logistics Engine: algorithms for real\-time vehicle routing, Optimization
* Mapping/Routing: OpenStreetMap, Open Source Routing Machine, Traffic forecasting algorithms
* Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform, Redis, PostgreSQL, Celery, RabbitMQ
* Health/Monitoring: AWS CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana
* Development Processes: Agile, CI/CD, Jenkins, zero\-downtime software updates


**Qualifications and Experience:**


**Required:**


* 2\+ years of experience in Software Development, preferably with high performance algorithms or data intensive applications.
* A deep and intuitive understanding of Algorithms and Data Structures.
* Ability to process, assimilate, and explain complex and abstract concepts from research publications.


**Preferred:**



Specialized knowledge. Seeking candidates with expertise in two or more of the following:


* Combinatorics and Discrete Optimization
* Online Algorithms
* Data Science / Machine Learning
* Open Street Maps or Open Source Routing Machine
* Distributed computing / Web Scale architectures.


**Education:**


* Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical discipline.


**Compensation and Benefits:**


* **Base Salary**: $90K\- $120K \+ performance\-based bonus or stock options.
* **Work\-Life Balance \& Additional Perks**: Flex\-time work schedules, vacation time, bi\-weekly catered lunches, social events, casual dress code
* **Benefits Plan**: Medical, dental, prescription, life/health spending accounts and more
* **Work Environment**: Located in KW's most desirable work space in the heart of Uptown Waterloo
* **Commuter Program:** Complimentary rides to and from work in Waterloo Region


**Who we are:**



http://www.rideco.com



RideCo powers on\-demand transit. Public transit agencies and fleet operators use RideCo's cloud\-based software platform to provide on\-demand shared rides in dynamically routed buses and vans. RideCo is growing rapidly, and it is the most adopted on\-demand paratransit and microtransit software among the 10 largest cities in the United States. Our marquee clients include Philadelphia’s SEPTA, San Antonio Metro, and Houston Metro.


RideCo’s software powers a diverse range of use cases, including paratransit, residential/ suburban travel; first\-mile\-last\-mile connections for transit hubs; and corporate employee transportation. The success of these services is supported by the industry's best customer service, including a 95% plus customer retention rate. We are investing to scale up and capture the growing demand for on\-demand shared rides solutions.


*RideCo is proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer. We hire the best talent and strive to build a meritocratic culture. In accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act, accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. If you require special accommodation to complete any portion of the application or interview process, please mention this in your application.* \#Li\-Hybrid



Why is this role open? Existing Vacancy  

  

RideCo is committed to a fair and transparent recruitment process. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision\-making tools to screen, evaluate, or select candidates. All applications are reviewed and assessed by our hiring team.

Our **Portfolio Modelling \& Forecasting team in Manchester** develop models that support our gas and power energy portfolios and are looking for an experienced Data Scientist to work with key stakeholders to develop tailored insight into demand and portfolio forecasts.

**WHAT WILL YOU DO**

Working with key stakeholders in risk, sales portfolio optimisation, quant execution and risk you will


* Build, develop, and deploy forecasting models to support business requirements
* Collaborate with key stakeholders on portfolio insights and sensitivity modelling
* Advance the monitoring of model accuracy and performance
* Maintain a continuous learning approach to ensure solutions remain up to date
**WHAT WILL YOU BRING**

You will bring proven experience in a data science role demonstrating the ability to translate business challenges into analytical problems and develop data driven solutions. * Advanced analytical competencies

**ABOUT US**

Securing Energy for Europe – it’s a simple statement, with a bold ambition. SEFE is not just our name, but also encompasses everything that drives us. To accomplish this, we’re taking immediate action to secure gas supply – but also looking forward, to explore our role in the European energy transformation and how we can contribute to a stable and sustainable future.

  


SEFE, an international energy company, ensures the security of supply and drives the decarbonisation of its customers. SEFE’s activities span the energy value chain, from origination and trading to sales, transport, and storage. Through its decades\-long expertise in trading and the development of its LNG business, SEFE has become one of the most important suppliers to industrial customers in Europe, with an annual sales volume of 200 TWh of gas and power. Its 50,000 customers range from small businesses to municipalities and multinational organisations.
